highlights.title: Celine Dion poised for emotional comeback concert in Paris
highlights.summary: Celine Dion is set to return to the stage in Paris on Saturday for her first full concert in six years, capping a years-long battle with a rare autoimmune disorder and marking a major milestone in the Canadian superstar’s comeback.

highlights.title: Live: Saudi Arabia oil pipeline shut down after drone attack launched from Iraq
highlights.summary: Saudi Arabia shut down its crucial Eat-West pipeline after it was attacked on Thursday, threatening an important alternative route for crude exports from the Gulf. Iraq has chosen not to retaliate at this state, its foreign ministry said. Read about the day’s events as they unfolded on our liveblog.
